title: Integrated SiGe Front Ends
summary: I bring on-chip antennas and low-noise electronics together in fabrication-aware silicon-germanium architectures for demanding millimeter- and submillimeter-wave systems.
problem: How can antennas and active electronics be integrated on chip without losing sight of fabrication and measurement constraints?
approach: I combine antenna and front-end design in silicon-germanium processes, moving from ideal electromagnetic models to layouts that account for process layers, feeding structures, active stages, and practical characterization. My aim is to make highly integrated architectures measurable and useful at frequencies where packaging and interconnects become part of the RF problem.

title: Innovative Space Hardware
summary: I design high-frequency hardware for CubeSat telemetry and satellite communications.
problem: Which integrated RF technologies can translate into compact, robust communication systems?
approach: I connect common RF methods across nanosatellite telemetry and telecommand, and satellite communications. My projects emphasize compact hardware, dual circular polarization, and measurement strategies while keeping public industry descriptions within approved disclosure limits.

title: Measurement System Setup
summary: I validate antennas, arrays, radiometers, and high-frequency hardware using probe stations, VNAs, frequency extenders, coplanar probes, antenna chambers, and near-field measurement systems.
problem: How can mmWave and sub-THz antenna concepts be reliably validated under demanding fabrication and measurement constraints?
approach: I combine simulation and prototype development with calibrated probe-station measurements, VNA frequency extenders, GSG/GSGSG coplanar probes, near-field scanning, and chamber characterization to evaluate impedance, radiation patterns, gain, polarization, and beam steering.
